Hi Camila / Aditya,

I'm Samir, founder at QClass — a student-run edtech accelerator company building tutoring orchestration for community colleges. We're preparing a 6-week pilot with LearnLaunch (Elena cc'ed) and were hoping to apply for any early-stage / education credits you offer for hosted API usage.

High level: 3 tutors, ~8k tokens/day expected during pilot peak, mostly short-generation prompts (feedback + scoring). We're a pre-seed student team with few paying customers; budget is limited.

Questions:
- Are there baseline eligibility criteria for academic/startup credits?

- What documentation would you need (student org confirmation, LOI from LearnLaunch, usage estimates)?

I've attached a short usage snapshot and can share the pilot plan if helpful. Would appreciate a quick yes/no on whether this is an acceptable request and next steps.

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and context, this is exactly the kind of cohort we consider for education credit. Short answers up front: yes, there is a pathway; we need (1) confirmation from the supporting accelerator/edu partner, (2) brief org proof (student status or non-profit registration), and (3) expected peak/day token estimates.

Next steps I propose:
- Please send a one-line confirmation from LearnLaunch OR an LOI (email from Elena is fine)
- Upload the student org roster or a screenshot of the campus affiliation page
- We'll provision a pilot coupon covering up to $1,500 of hosted API spend or up to 100k tokens (whichever comes first) for the 6-week period.

I've attached our EDU eligibility checklist for your reference — it lists acceptable documentation and timelines. If you can get Elena to reply with a short note we can start the internal approval.

I'll coordinate with finance once Elena confirms.

Best,

Quick update from finance: we can approve a $1,500 pilot coupon for QClass tied to the LearnLaunch LOI. We prefer milestone-split (50% at activation, 50% after pilot close and basic usage reconciliation).

If they exceed 100k tokens we will automatically move them to a throttled pay-as-you-go plan with rate-limits (preserve latency SLO but limit throughput) and notify the primary contact before any charge is applied — act as a mitigation layer rather than an immediate invoice. No full MPA required for this scale; a short acknowledgement email from the founder accepting the coupon terms is sufficient.

Samir — please reply to confirm you accept: (1) 50/50 coupon split, (2) auto-fallback to throttled paid plan if >100k tokens, and (3) LOI from LearnLaunch uploaded by May 20.

I'll issue the first coupon upon receiving the LOI and your acknowledgement.

Thanks,
